note: RV park on Lake of the Woods (sand-bottom lake) near Decatur, with a sandy beach and boat slips. Mostly seasonal: the park map marks 17 of its 162 sites for daily, weekly or monthly stays, all of them inland from the lake. No tents; the policy page says pets are allowed on non-holiday weekends only (2026-10-22). --Claude
summary: Operator site live: 2027 daily full-hookup rate $55 ($75 holidays) for 2 adults + 2 children, 162 full-hookup 30/50-amp sites with pull-throughs, showers/laundry/dump/store, open May 1 - Oct 15 2026, booked by phone only, 3-night holiday minimum. Added fees and booking; confirmed hookups, count and season. Park map: only 17 sites (blue) are daily/weekly/monthly, none on the lakeshore. Note: dropped text now in fields and the unsourced 16-pull-through count; added the seasonal share and the tent/pet rules.
flags: Price gate: base rate $55/night (2027 daily full hookup, non-holiday; $75 holidays) is over US$50, no gateway within 40 km (Grand Rapids 99 km), and the family has never stayed here - fails the gate (and long-stay test 1). Likely drop.

Mostly seasonal (long-stay five tests): the park map marks 17 of 162 sites as daily/weekly/monthly (~10.5%), so test 4 passes narrowly; nightly rate posted with a phone (test 2 ok); 3-night minimum only on holiday weekends (test 3 ok); no homes or lots sold (test 5 ok); test 1 fails on price ($55).

Waterfront re-audit lead: the entry is 'lakefront', but the park map shows every lakeshore site (13-34, X-Z) is seasonal; all 17 daily/weekly/monthly sites (92-95, 111-118, 121-125) sit inland, so no site a transient can book is on the water.
Booking is by phone only (no online engine); presence met by a working website with phone 269-423-7311 (matches; Google: open, 4.6 / 115 reviews).
